title: Stages of Purity
subtitle: Tainted, Cleansing, Absolved, Purified
text: Purity accumulates through action and restraint. Killing creatures of blood and undead, sleeping with Hemolysis active, breeding animals, tending crops and pets, and above all refusing to use blood magic — these deeds earn purity. There are four recognized stages. Tainted (25): the Verdigris Aura first appears. Cleansing (50): the aura deepens. Absolved (75): you strike harder against hemomantic creatures. Purified (100): the aura reaches its fullest extent, and the path to Clarity opens.
